rows.label: qst712002_msg0001
rows.name:
What is it? That hesitation on your
faces isn't like you.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0002
rows.name:
Hmm? You want a review of the
third-stage Blade Combo? Very well...

rows.label: qst712002_msg0003
rows.name:
As I said before, Blade Combos chain
Specials together, and the third stage
works the same way as the second.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0004
rows.name:
Use Specials in order: level I, level
II or higher, then level III, to
trigger a third-stage Blade Combo.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0005
rows.name:
Also, for those of you who cleared
the last test, I must tell you
about the "Critical Route."

rows.label: qst712002_msg0006
rows.name:
A Critical Route is a Blade Combo that
deals higher damage than normal with
a Special of a specific element.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0007
rows.name:
As far as I know, a Critical Route is
activated when you use Specials in the
order of "Fire" > "Fire" > "Light."

rows.label: qst712002_msg0008
rows.name:
There are plenty more critical routes,
so use this test as a chance to look
for some.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0009
rows.name:
Whether you activate a Critical Route
won't count in this test's grade, so
don't worry.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0010
rows.name:
Of course, any pattern of Blade
Combo will count as one as long as
you connect it to the third stage.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0011
rows.name:
Also, as before, location and target
don't matter. Practice it wherever,
against any opponent you like.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0012
rows.name: Well then, I have high hopes for you.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0102
rows.name:
I had high hopes, but I never
thought someone would actually
pass this test...!

rows.label: qst712002_msg0103
rows.name:
You're probably the only ones who can
keep up with us on our next mission.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0104
rows.name:
The final decision is up to my Driver,
Gororo, but I'm sure Gororo will
approve of you.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0105
rows.name:
We're meeting Gororo in an area of
Iira called Aletta.

rows.label: qst712002_msg0106
rows.name:
If you happen to stop by Aletta,
come talk to us.
